name: Visa
summary:
Visa is the card network at visa.com. The blue-and-gold wordmark in the tab is the favicon for that corporate site, not a card-art scan.

Checked 12 November 2026 against visa.com. HTML came from https://www.visa.com/en-us (HTTP 200). Icon link tags: icon → https://www.visa.com/vcom-assets/content/dam/visa/favicon.ico.

The favicon.ico URL is https://www.visa.com/vcom-assets/content/dam/visa/favicon.ico. The saved file favicon.ico is 15406 bytes. Directory sizes: 16×16, 32×32, 48×48.

No apple-touch-icon URL was declared, and the well-known apple-touch-icon.png path did not return an image.

No brand colour could be derived. The page had no theme-color, mask-icon colour, or manifest theme_color, and a dominant pixel colour was not readable from the saved PNGs.

The only measured sizes are inside favicon.ico: 16×16, 32×32, 48×48.
